_comment: Tool side of the code-rust bat-2393 session (the recorded Codex bundle that coderust_codex_bat2393 and coderust_bat2393_rustc come from), captured in the agentcpu_rust image (9ce068ff3624) with the per-process mode of run_simpoint_trace.py and SCARAB_PER_PROCESS_THREADS=all: every thread of every process of the Codex tree becomes its own workload, <workload>_<exe>_<pid> for the largest thread of a process and <workload>_<exe>_<pid>_t<tid> for the others, with SimPoints at 60 M instructions or more and simulated whole below; per_process_manifest.json in the workload home has instructions and shares per thread. The replay (workloads/agentcpu_rust/codex_tools_replay.sh) runs natively and starts codex through the drrun shell wrapper (SCARAB_TRACE_SHELL_VAR=CODEX_TRACE_SHELL), children followed, so codex and everything it starts (bash, cargo, rustc with its LLVM threads, gcc/cc1/as, ld, build scripts, test binaries, git) are traced while the replay proxy and the checkout reset are not. The codex process is converted too, each of its threads as its own workload (coderust_bat2393_tools_codex_<pid> for its largest thread), so that it can stand in for the registered coderust_codex_bat2393 (captured with the image's PATH and DR 10.0, see below) if wanted; the registered workloads are not touched. The proxy (codex_replay_quiesce.py) serves the recorded answers only once codex has no running descendants, so the build and test commands that DynamoRIO slows run to the end instead of being cut when the recorded session moves on or ends. workload_root_entrypoint.sh gives /testbed to the trace uid (as root-owned target/ the libgit2-sys build script fails with EPERM). The job fails unless the replay prints RC=0, MISSES=0, CALLS=14, the recorded patch hash 2c044fbd91137d6e and the recorded command-output hash 02d428d560bb79b7 (codex_hash.py). To give the recorded outputs, the replay reproduces the recording's shell: the trace user's login shell is /bin/bash (workload_root_entrypoint.sh; Codex runs every command with the passwd shell, -lc), and a login profile drops /usr/local/cargo/bin from PATH as the task image's /etc/profile did for root, so cargo build fails at steps 6 and 8 and runs once, at step 9, as recorded. The hash is computed over completed commands, so it does not depend on whether a command was reported as still running when the model's next answer came. A first attempt (coderust_bat2393_tools.failed_hang_step8_20261028) ran with the image's PATH (build at step 6 and again at step 8) and hung in step 8 inside the libgit2-sys build script under DynamoRIO. The capture uses one cargo build job (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1, approved 2026-10-28): at default parallelism DynamoRIO 10.0, 11.3.0 and 11.90 all crash or hang on rustc and on the libgit2-sys build script (vfork child stuck in a futex wait, SIGSEGV), while one job traces cleanly; untraced, the instructions of each rustc process with one job are 0.997 to 1.005 times those at default parallelism (0.9996 in total), so only the scheduling of rustc's codegen work across threads changes. The reasons are copied into per_process_manifest.json (capture_note, from agentcpu_trace_tools_coderust.note.txt). DynamoRIO is the 11.3.0 release baked into agentcpu_rust (SCARAB_TRACE_DR_HOME, for capture, drraw2trace and counting): with the image's DR 10.0 a second attempt (coderust_bat2393_tools.failed_segv_step9_20261028) passed the replay with the recorded shell but a rustc compiling console died with SIGSEGV in step 9, and the first attempt deadlocked in a forked child of the libgit2-sys build script. 11.3.0 writes the trace format of the DR source Scarab reads with (cronbuild-11.90.20140: trace version 6, offline file version 8). Paths are bohr1's; scarab_path is a standalone clone at 4f63964 (agentcpu-trace-support-2: 0617432 plus the BBV rep-assert fix that git_262 needed), used only for fingerprinting; a worktree cannot update its submodules inside the container.

trace_configurations.env_vars: SCARAB_PER_PROCESS=1 SCARAB_PER_PROCESS_THREADS=all SCARAB_TRACE_SHELL_VAR=CODEX_TRACE_SHELL SCARAB_TRACE_DR_HOME=/tmp_home/DynamoRIO-Linux-11.3.0-1 SCARAB_PER_PROCESS_JOBS=16 TRACE_KEEP_RAW=1 SCARAB_PER_PROCESS_RESTORE=replay_out/target_modules CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 SCARAB_PER_PROCESS_NOTE_FILE=/scarab_infra/json/agentcpu_trace_tools_coderust.note.txt HOME=/tmp PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.cpu.hwcaps=-AVX512F,-AVX512BW,-AVX512DQ,-AVX512VL
